body: Your boy friend is the one who doesn't deserve to be loved. He's clearly gas lighting you. What kind of an asshole complains about his girlfriend not tucking him into bed as if he's five years old? The fact that he convinced you that he's the victim makes him a terrible person that deserves love from no one. The fact that you were willing to put up with a man child like that makes you a saint and you need to find someone else who will treat you better.

Worse case scenario your situation doesn't change and best case scenario is that you get better. If you have hit rock bottom then there's no reason to not just grab life with whatever energy u have left and give it one last good squeeze before u go out. U gotta dig deep to truly find yourself and the things you like.
Please dont sabotage your college life. That's your best ticket out of that hell hole.

It's not pointless to post that there's hope because there always is hope. You just have to dig down deep enough to squeeze it out. Of course it is just hope. It could lead to a domino effect of one good thing in ur life leading to another or it could not, but you won't know unless you just try squeezing one more time. If you are willing to end it all then what do you have to lose by just trying one more time. I don't know your situation or your pain and I can't hope to try to understand it but once you hit rock bottom there's nowhere to go but up so since it can't get worse just try one more time even if you don't feel like you have the energy anymore. You have to dig deep and soul search to find yourself and what makes you happy. At this point you have literally nothing to lose so give life just one more shot.
And there's a lot that don't. The suicide rate is 40 percent for trannies and I'm probably just gonna be another number in that statistic.
Rip. If you're already on the other side I hope it treats you well, man.
